style: 3D cartoon, Pixar quality, deadpan satire, high mountain noon
motion_rule: EVERY second something huge crosses or fills the frame: a flying bill, the herd, her tail, the marmot's face or the whole paper blizzard. Lens fully covered five times
camera_moves: wide, macro of her eye at 7.5, wide again at 8.8
character: a lean mountain puma on a flat rock, half-closed golden eyes, utterly calm, a neat stack of paper bills under one paw; she never hurries
cast: the MARMOT: fat, sitting right at the lens filling half the screen, chewing without pause, never running. The HERD below: goats and deer streaking past in a blur, always at full speed
props: BILLS: plain pale paper slips, no letters or numbers, only a small embossed percent shape. ROCK: one flat slab, she lies on it all clip. Nothing is stacked on anything
prop_continuity: the stack under her paw shrinks all clip: full at 0.0, half at 4.2, gone at 8.0; one bill ends up flattened under the marmot
environment: a sunlit mountain ledge, dry grass, blue sky, a valley far below where the herd runs
lighting: blazing high-altitude noon, hard sun, crisp shadows, high exposure

audio.language: Russian, lines verbatim; latin hints never spoken
audio.delivery: lazy satisfied female voice, calm, even 4.3 syllables/sec
audio.pacing: pauses only at 1.4-2.2, 3.6-4.2 and 7.0-7.5; the 4.2 and 5.6 lines run together with no breath; voiceless after 8.0, sfx keep going
audio.lip_sync: mouth opens and closes clearly on every syllable, never a voice over
audio.sfx: paper rustle on every bill, drumming hooves from the valley, the marmot's steady chewing, silence of paper settling at the end

timeline.a: silent. A single bill flutters INTO THE LENS, covers the frame and slides away, revealing her on the rock; far below the herd streaks past
she leans down at the lens until her face fills the whole frame, eyes half shut
silent. She flicks one bill off the stack: it spins right past the lens and drops to the valley, and the herd surges faster
she stretches her whole body along the rock, the tail sweeping the full width of the frame
silent. The fat MARMOT rises into frame at the lens, half the screen, chewing, not running
she rakes half the stack off the rock and the bills blizzard down across the whole frame
no breath. The herd tears through the frame edge to edge in a wall of dust
silent, the only stop. Nothing moves but the marmot's jaw, right at the lens
macro on one golden eye, dead still into the lens
silent. She shoves the whole remaining stack over the edge; the paper fills the lens completely
silent. The paper clears: the marmot has flattened one bill into a pillow, lies down on it and shuts his eyes; dust settles

must_appear: bills crossing the lens, the herd always running, the MARMOT never running and never hurried, the stack shrinking to nothing, the marmot asleep on a bill at the end
negative_prompt: letters, numbers, cyrillic, logos, readable text on the bills, subtitles, watermark, the marmot running, the herd standing still, coins, night, dusk, dark scene, dim light, people, hands, floating props, a second puma, slow motion, speed ramp, the puma standing still in a wide shot, any voice from her after 8.0, silence in the tail, accented Russian, drawn-out delivery, grain
